leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function that accepts a string and returns the index of the first non-repeating character.
Construct a frequency map to count character occurrences within the string.
Apply linear iteration to identify the first character with a frequency of one.
Manipulate string indices to return the correct position or -1 for no unique character.
Integrate the solution into a complete, executable JavaScript program.
Control edge cases such as empty strings or strings with all repeating characters.
Initialize and update the frequency map using appropriate data structures.
